occurrences.text: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
